decision_cruda.rationale: Radio and CMMS agree that LH-01 (N600-09, 3/4/5 h) and LH-05 (E543-11, 1.5/2/2.5 h) are down, so no confirmation is needed. Norte: 2 working LH514 at 220 m give about 2x35.6 = 71 t/h. Three trucks haul about 3x40/0.39 h x 0.227 = 70 t/h, and the stockpile holds 242 t. Norte is truck-limited, so an extra loader adds almost nothing and I leave it uncovered. Este: with LH-05 down, mucking stops, the stockpile is only 49 t, and the trucks can haul about 72 t/h. The stope has 285 t left at 8.3 g/t, which is 0.267 oz/t. A loan to TJ-E543-11 is worthwhile. Options: LH-08 comes from DS-C538-01, an infrastructure heading that costs only 0.2 oz/h. Travel is about 0.55 h, so it arrives around 10:05. An LH410 at 280 m gives 30x100/127 = 23.6 t/h, which is about 6.3 oz/h. It works about 0.9 h until 11:00 and about 1.4 h if the repair runs to 12:00. Expected gain is about 5.8 oz, less about 0.3-0.5 oz of lost development, so about +5 oz. LH-09 is in the critical-path heading DS-E543-02 at 4.0 oz/h. Moving it nets only about 2.3 oz/h, so it is worse. Taking a Central LH514 would cut a truck-limited Central, where 3 loaders at about 96 t/h match the trucks' 95 t/h, so I rejected that. LH-10 is in preventive maintenance until 11:00 and would arrive too late to help. No reserves, because no stope is stopped.
